computational_problem: allocate a bounded active workspace
abstraction: token-budgeted working set with explicit admission and eviction
implementation_examples: context windows; scratchpads; MemGPT/Letta tiering
primary_risk: context tokens are passive inputs and not a central executive
next_test: dynamic context builder versus fixed top-k and full recent context at equal tokens

computational_problem: preserve individual events without catastrophic overwrite
abstraction: append-only evidence-bearing episode store
implementation_examples: experience buffers; event logs; Generative Agents; Mem0
primary_risk: digital exact storage can hide failures of capture and access
next_test: raw immutable episode versus extracted fact and summary at equal retrieval budget

computational_problem: generalize across episodes while retaining exceptions
abstraction: evidence-linked semantic views over episodes
implementation_examples: knowledge graphs; reflections; ExpeL; ICAL; MIRIX semantic memory
primary_risk: summaries can invent rules and erase exceptions
next_test: flat episodes versus provenance-linked semantic rules on transfer and correction

computational_problem: balance rapid specificity with slow generalization
abstraction: separate fast episodic and slow semantic/procedural stores
implementation_examples: CLS-inspired continual learning; MIRIX; dual-store agent designs
primary_risk: calling two databases hippocampus and cortex does not implement CLS
next_test: dual store versus homogeneous store with equal capacity context and maintenance cost

computational_problem: stabilize and integrate episodes over longer timescales
abstraction: versioned episode-to-rule transformation with provenance
implementation_examples: generative replay; reflection; background memory managers
primary_risk: offline summarization may be mere compression or repeated hallucination
next_test: no consolidation versus extractive versus generative evidence-linked consolidation

computational_problem: allocate maintenance to experiences likely to alter future behavior
abstraction: budgeted phase-conditioned replay sampler
implementation_examples: experience replay; generative replay; reflection loops
primary_risk: extra compute and poison amplification can masquerade as replay benefit
next_test: targeted versus random sham corrupted and direct-retrieval controls at equal cost

computational_problem: distinguish highly similar episodes and reduce interference
abstraction: entity time source and task scoped representations with false-merge detection
implementation_examples: contrastive learning; sparse coding; scoped retrieval
primary_risk: over-separation destroys useful generalization and duplicates facts
next_test: similar-episode factorial measuring recall false merge duplicate rate and source confusion

computational_problem: recover a stored episode from partial or transformed cues
abstraction: controlled multi-cue graph expansion with evidence checks
implementation_examples: Hopfield networks; graph retrieval; HippoRAG Personalized PageRank
primary_risk: completion can confidently blend episodes or invent missing links
next_test: weak-cue recall crossed with distractor density and false-completion scoring

computational_problem: retrieve when later cues differ or depend on original context
abstraction: preserve multiple cue views and source context
implementation_examples: metadata filters; hybrid retrieval; query expansion
primary_risk: too much context reinstates irrelevant state and increases intrusion
next_test: paraphrase language temporal and task-context cue interventions under fixed top-k

computational_problem: remember where a claim came from and how it was acquired
abstraction: typed provenance and evidence-event links
implementation_examples: citations; provenance graphs; event sourcing
primary_risk: a plausible citation may not entail the claim or preserve authorization
next_test: claim correctness crossed with source correctness completeness and authorization

computational_problem: distinguish versions sequence and recency without collapsing time
abstraction: valid-time transaction-time and sequence-aware indexing
implementation_examples: temporal databases; Graphiti; TiMem; Ledger-QA
primary_risk: recency can override valid older facts and timestamp parsing can leak templates
next_test: versioned histories with natural relative dates stale intrusions and delayed return

computational_problem: revise a re-used memory while preserving prior evidence
abstraction: retrieval-triggered candidate revision with append-only supersession
implementation_examples: versioned memory updates; Memory-R1 UPDATE; CLIN-like rule revision
primary_risk: retrieval-triggered overwrite can corrupt correct originals and replication boundaries are narrow
next_test: no update versus append-both in-place overwrite and evidence-bearing supersession

computational_problem: reduce competition from related non-target memories after selective retrieval
abstraction: reversible competitor suppression conditioned on query scope
implementation_examples: inhibitory control models; negative sampling; reranking suppression
primary_risk: suppression can hide critical alternatives or encode popularity bias
next_test: target retrieval plus collateral recall recovery and scope-shift tests

computational_problem: remove or reduce access to information that impairs current behavior
abstraction: archive suppression and index exclusion with recovery
implementation_examples: learned deletion; decay; Unable-to-Forget benchmark; MemCon forgetting
primary_risk: physical deletion is irreversible and reward can suppress rare critical evidence
next_test: save-all versus archive suppression deletion and oracle under utility reversal

computational_problem: remember to perform a future action when a condition occurs
abstraction: external triggerable intention with validity rescue and completion state
implementation_examples: calendars; schedulers; tool triggers; reminders
primary_risk: polling cost false triggers stale intentions and unsafe autonomous action
next_test: triggered commitment versus ordinary retrieval with delayed cues and revocation

computational_problem: decide whether to retrieve reformulate ask stop answer or abstain
abstraction: typed monitor state controlling search actions
implementation_examples: selective prediction; semantic uncertainty; learned retrieval triggers
primary_risk: confidence and backend agreement share common-mode error
next_test: typed controller versus scalar confidence always-search and never-search risk-coverage curves

computational_problem: prioritize limited encoding consolidation and retrieval resources by consequence
abstraction: multidimensional consequence urgency valence and controllability signals
implementation_examples: importance scores; Generative Agents; Amygdala; affective memory prototypes
primary_risk: dramatic content crowds out neutral critical evidence and is easy to poison
next_test: factorized salience ablation with collateral-memory and adversarial-emotional-language tests

biological_mechanism: reward prediction error effects on memory
computational_problem: update allocation when outcomes differ from expectation
abstraction: calibrated signed prediction-error feature separated from reward magnitude
implementation_examples: temporal-difference learning; surprise-weighted memory; MemRL
primary_risk: prediction error depends on a possibly wrong predictor and novelty is not future utility
next_test: prediction error versus reward magnitude surprise relevance and causal future utility

computational_problem: temporarily mark weak events for later stabilization when related novelty occurs
abstraction: expiring eligibility tag plus linked later promotion
implementation_examples: eligibility traces in RL; delayed write queues
primary_risk: global novelty promotes unrelated noise and leaks future information
next_test: temporal and semantic linkage factorial with expired and sham tags

computational_problem: integrate consistent experiences faster after stable structure exists
abstraction: evidence-linked schema induction with exception and conflict slots
implementation_examples: rule induction; ExpeL; ICAL; reflection trees
primary_risk: premature schemas create confirmation bias and erase exceptions
next_test: episode-only versus induced schema with counterexamples distribution shift and rollback

computational_problem: reuse action policies without re-deriving every step
abstraction: versioned executable or declarative skill with preconditions outcomes and rollback
implementation_examples: Voyager skill library; procedural stores; MIRIX; Acontext
primary_risk: procedures become stale execute outside scope or bypass evidence checks
next_test: first-action procedural transfer with interference inhibition and stale-skill reversal

computational_problem: choose cached procedures only when current outcome model supports them
abstraction: state and consequence conditioned skill gate
implementation_examples: model-based versus model-free RL; planner-skill arbitration
primary_risk: a stress metaphor may hard-code unsafe procedural bias and null evidence is ignored
next_test: goal devaluation and rule-change benchmark with no-shift baseline

computational_problem: improve later accessibility by successful effortful retrieval
abstraction: verified-use rehearsal separated from access frequency
implementation_examples: spaced-repetition systems; replay; use-count ranking
primary_risk: self-reinforcing popularity amplifies wrong memories and exposure bias
next_test: verified successful retrieval versus exposure count restudy and random rehearsal

computational_problem: schedule repetitions to improve delayed retention under limited practice
abstraction: adaptive review interval with uncertainty and consequence constraints
implementation_examples: spaced repetition; Leitner/SM-2 schedulers
primary_risk: fixed decay curves assume stationary value and can over-rehearse easy items
next_test: massed versus fixed-spaced adaptive-spaced and no-replay delayed transfer

computational_problem: suppress an obsolete response without assuming the original trace vanished
abstraction: context-conditioned supersession and safe fallback
implementation_examples: policy deactivation; validity rules; refusal memories
primary_risk: suppressed stale behavior can spontaneously return in a new context
next_test: overwrite versus coexistence suppression and deletion with renewal/reinstatement probes

computational_problem: select which concurrent events share or separate representations
abstraction: temporary eligibility plus competition and capacity budget
implementation_examples: mixture routing; sparse expert allocation; clustering
primary_risk: allocation can merge unrelated events and create salience monopolies
next_test: concurrent-event linkage and interference test under matched capacity

computational_problem: navigate relations and transfer across structurally similar situations
abstraction: typed relational graph with temporal and provenance edges
implementation_examples: knowledge graphs; successor representations; HippoRAG; Graphiti
primary_risk: graph construction errors create false paths and topology can leak labels
next_test: graph versus sparse dense and hybrid retrieval on multi-hop and false-path cases

computational_problem: bind distributed features into retrievable episode indexes
abstraction: entity-relation index pointing to immutable evidence
implementation_examples: indexing models; HippoRAG graph plus Personalized PageRank
primary_risk: branding graph retrieval as hippocampal does not validate the mapping
next_test: reproduce HippoRAG against BM25 dense graph and oracle under identical reader budget

computational_problem: select when to update maintain or clear active representations
abstraction: typed admission update clear and protect gate for context
implementation_examples: gated recurrent networks; context managers; MemGPT; MemCon
primary_risk: one learned gate couples capture retrieval and deletion errors
next_test: factorized update/maintain/clear controller versus LRU relevance and oracle

computational_problem: prevent runaway strengthening while preserving responsive learning
abstraction: bounded normalization and per-source/per-type budgets
implementation_examples: weight normalization; quotas; rate limits
primary_risk: normalization can erase genuinely unequal importance and hide attacks
next_test: unbounded salience versus global and typed homeostatic budgets under repeated events

computational_problem: separate online action from maintenance and test phase-specific operations
abstraction: explicit task-active idle and maintenance phases
implementation_examples: background workers; Sleeping LLM prototypes; scheduled consolidation
primary_risk: nightly batch processing is not evidence for sleep mechanisms and may age data
next_test: online-only versus idle maintenance with identical total compute and freshness controls

computational_problem: retain earlier distributions without storing or replaying every exact sample
abstraction: generated rehearsal linked to source episodes and uncertainty
implementation_examples: deep generative replay; generative continual concept learning
primary_risk: generated pseudo-episodes hallucinate and laundering destroys provenance
next_test: exact extractive and generated replay under forgetting fidelity and poison metrics

computational_problem: maintain stable user or agent commitments while representing change
abstraction: versioned core identity/preference records distinct from episodes
implementation_examples: Generative Agents; MIRIX core memory; Letta persona memory
primary_risk: summarized identity freezes outdated sensitive inferences and encourages anthropomorphism
next_test: core-memory versus episodic-only with preference change consent export and correction

computational_problem: past exposure biases later processing without explicit recall
abstraction: first-action behavioral influence trace separated from factual retrieval
implementation_examples: prompt priming; in-context examples; ImplicitMemBench
primary_risk: unwanted implicit bias and contamination can look like useful memory
next_test: paired prime/control first-action test with factual recall hidden

computational_problem: learn predictive cue-outcome associations that alter first decisions
abstraction: typed cue-consequence policy proposal with explicit safety gate
implementation_examples: associative RL; ImplicitMemBench conditioning probes
primary_risk: automatic cue-driven action can encode manipulation bias and unsafe reflexes
next_test: preference versus inhibition conditioning with reversal and adversarial cue tests

computational_problem: retain information across short and long horizons without one brittle decay rate
abstraction: multiple reversible tiers with typed transition rules
implementation_examples: cascade models; tiered caches; MemGPT/Letta; TiMem
primary_risk: tier metaphors conflate access latency value and legal retention
next_test: single decay versus fixed tiers typed tiers and oracle across delay distributions

computational_problem: prepare plausible future action sequences before direct experience
abstraction: sandboxed simulation memory with provenance and non-factual status
implementation_examples: planning rollouts; model-based RL; self-play traces
primary_risk: simulations contaminate factual memory and confirmation loops reward fantasies
next_test: planning with separated simulated traces versus merged memory and no preplay

computational_problem: distinguish observed external events from inference simulation and generation
abstraction: mandatory origin type confidence and evidence boundary
implementation_examples: data lineage; provenance labels; synthetic-data tags
primary_risk: model-generated summaries can be re-ingested as observations and become false facts
next_test: observed inferred simulated and generated source discrimination with recursive ingestion
